title: 上线后，创始人别当中转站
series: The Founder's Playbook - Building an AI-Native Startup
audience: Founders, solo builders, AI startup operators, and technical product leaders

visualSystem.visualJob: Launch-stage founder bottleneck and system replacement
visualSystem.styleIntent: reuse Founder Playbook warm decision-gate VI while changing the central artifact to routing pressure and attention audit lanes
typography: Rounded / humanist Chinese sans stack from the Founder Playbook system
Avenir Next / Inter / system sans for metadata
palette: amber for launch gate and founder judgment
cyan for repeatable systems and automation

symbolGrammar: Before designing any symbol, identify the section key message. The symbol must encode that takeaway, not merely the section topic or a noun from the narration.
Comply with the locked Founder Playbook VI first.
Use abstract concept marks: router node, queue pressure, launch gate, system router, and attention audit lanes.
Fit every symbol to the concept: routing pressure converges into one founder node; launch gate separates product existence from repeatable growth; recurring work sorts into lanes.
Keep each mark readable at phone size with short labels as anchors.
motionPrinciples: One visual focus per voice chunk.
Motion is semantic: request convergence, gate transition, loop flip, queue buildup, attention-lane sorting, system replacement.
Subtitles must stay clear of the central router and audit diagrams.
Animation order and hold time follow measured voice timing.
frameFittingConstraints: No scene may rely on dense process text for meaning.
Every diagram must remain readable in a phone feed.
Subtitles must not sit in a box or collide with central artifacts.

sourceRefs.role: source value inventory and page-area mapping

sourceFidelityGuardrails: Launch is about repeatable business growth, not just product existence.
Founder-in-the-loop is useful early but becomes a bottleneck when every operational loop depends on founder attention.
The founder should not disappear; founder time is reserved for direction, tradeoff, and risk judgment.
Operations without founder bottlenecks is a launch-stage exit criterion.
Security, compliance, enterprise readiness, and full growth metrics remain deferred.
episodeClaims: After launch, every issue cannot still route through the founder.
MVP proves the product deserves to exist; Launch proves the business can repeatedly grow.
Founder involvement shifts from learning advantage to operational bottleneck.
Delayed decisions, support queues, bug routing gaps, and remembered-only reports expose the bottleneck.
Founder-handled work should be sorted into automation, delegation, and founder-only judgment.
